checks.detail: Fail: fresh runtime state confirmed 18 stable identities split 3 Alpha, 5 Bravo and 10 Charlie, and ordinary Alpha samples entered grounded search and walk states with distinct route slots, but no uninterrupted 3/5/10 encounter proved perception-through-death, reciprocal shot occlusion, reload, hit reaction, cover changes or deadlock freedom; coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_occupancy_occlusion.586166354018=insufficient_evidence; coverage.baseline.accelerated_branch_setup.7ee212621d20=insufficient_evidence;

Fail: adjacent Alpha samples resolved Idle and Walk clips and the success branch produced a front-facing third-person dance; the corrected captured-input receipt additionally proved horizontal yaw -150.018 to -170.186 and vertical pitch 0 to 12.605 with mouse_captured true, while a 2200 millisecond AUTO hold overlapped nonzero look and returned the viewmodel to its authored position and rotation; the required A/B/C idle, locomotion, aim, fire, reload, hurt and death matrix with weapon-family and socket checks remains incomplete; coverage.baseline.fps_enemy_animation_semantics.b0796d84f6aa=insufficient_evidence;
Candidate source and bound gameplay frames still violate the equipped-weapon HUD or player-paced story-cue contract.

Fail: title, loadout, briefing, gameplay, pause, settings, success, failure and replay were reachable and default 100 percent scale was restored, but 200 percent settings content clipped and the loadout and result pages remained text-led card or prose surfaces below the required transparent AAA hierarchy; coverage.baseline.fps_shell_information_presentat.40d0f2cd0a9e=fail;

Run the complete mission at 1920x1080 after initial load with raw frame-time samples and repeat restart/replay three times. Target 60 FPS and no sustained explosion dip below 45 FPS for three frames. Reject fatal Godot errors, crash, soft lock, input/camera/collision escape, duplicated enemies or events, unbounded particles/audio/corpses/signals, navigation deadlock, texture shimmer, disappearing map surfaces or state drift after restart.

Issue one integrated verdict for the complete Fusepoint vertical slice across world, movement, both weapons, 18 enemies, A/B capture, C defusal, HUD/minimap, story, audio/VFX, ordinary death, success, detonation failure, menus, accessibility and restart stability. Require continuous current-candidate evidence and name the highest-impact blocker; source inspection, labels, beauty frames or self-reported completion are insufficient.

required_criteria.requirement: Play fresh uninterrupted encounters against the required 3 Alpha, 5 Bravo and 10 Charlie enemies. Verify multiple spatial clusters, autonomous locomotion, navigation separation, perception, search, flank, cover reservation, aim telegraph, fire, reload, hit reaction and death. Reject static or duplicated enemies, first-frame fire, wall tracking, teleporting, sliding poses, overlapping capsules, doorway deadlocks, frozen groups or damage without a real enemy shot event.

Inspect continuous motion for player weapons/hands and all visible enemy states. Require stable roots and sockets, weapon-hand contact, locomotion without foot sliding, readable aim/fire/hurt/death transitions, no T-pose or transform-only substitute, and third-person victory dance framing that faces the user after combat freezes.

Bind state logs, continuous frames and audio for player/enemy fire, near miss, material impact, player damage, enemy hit, kill and death. Require synchronized muzzle flash, animation, recoil, projectile/tracer or pellet result, occlusion, impact VFX/audio, red edge damage mask, camera response and a restrained right-side yellow kill notification such as 'YOU KILLED' without opaque cards or debug labels. Enemy death must have clear animation and sound feedback.

Execute both terminal paths from ordinary gameplay. Success must atomically defuse before zero, freeze combat, move to a safe third-person camera, play the character victory dance, show score/time/rank and offer replay/home. Failure must atomically detonate at zero, set health to zero once, disable combat, layer flash/fire/sparks/debris/shockwave/dust/light/audio, shake then lower the camera, expand and decay the red damage mask, play the failure video or still fallback, and offer retry/home without a generic Game Over label.

Navigate title, briefing/loading, loadout, gameplay, pause, settings, ordinary death recovery, success result, failure result and replay using keyboard/mouse and gamepad. Require coherent grounded typography and transparent AAA-style information hierarchy, visible focus/hover/pressed states, truthful paused HUD snapshot, readable 200 percent UI scale, subtitles, motion reduction and persisted settings. Reject default fonts, card grids, large opaque color blocks, deep-blue borders, slash-slash labels, debug text, focus traps or direct boot into gameplay.

Review daylight environment lighting, neutral exposure, contact shadows and event-driven audio/VFX across the complete mission. Require readable real materials, distinct weapon/mechanical/footstep/impact/enemy/objective/bomb/dialogue/ambience/music layers, bounded effects with world scale and surface response, and no clipping. Reject overexposure, bloom flicker, missing geometry during camera motion, darkness/fog/post effects hiding weak assets, silent kills or one sound/effect reused for unrelated events.
